text: Eliminative materialists such as the Churchlands argue that ___, our commonsense framework of beliefs, desires, and other propositional attitudes, is a radically false theory that a mature neuroscience will replace, much as chemistry discarded phlogiston.
explanation: Eliminativism treats folk psychology as an empirical theory (the 'theory-theory') whose posits may name nothing real, on a par with phlogiston or caloric. This distinguishes it sharply from the identity theory, which would preserve beliefs and desires by identifying them with brain states rather than eliminating them outright.
